versions.content: When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunction 0x04, the Dcm module shall obtain the status of the DTC by first calling Dem_SelectDTC() with the following parameters: • ClientId: Client Id for this Dcm instance (see DcmDemClientRef ) • DTC : DTC from the request • DTCOrigin: DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_PRIMARY_MEMORY and then Dem_GetStatusOfDTC() with ClientId = Client Id for this Dcm instance (see DcmDemClientRef )
